body:
Layer gets 4 new fields (X,Y,Scale,Rotation), backward-compatible (a layer that never sets them composites identically to before). New imCompositeTransformed: resize then rotate then position (correct order for a rotated bounding box), transparent background on rotate. New Service.SetTransform + PATCH .../transform, mirroring SetOpacity/SetVisible. Frontend LayerTransformPanel (X/Y inputs, scale/rotation sliders, Apply/Reset), same pattern as the existing hue/sat/sharpen panel. Real, found-live correction during testing: AddLayer's existing imFitToCanvas behavior fits every imported image to full canvas size before storage -- the test's first draft assumed small imports stay small; fixed the test, not the feature, once caught via failing pixel-sampled assertions (not just 'no error'). Real, end-to-end verified: go build/vet clean, full test suite passes including a new pixel-sampled test verifying actual ImageMagick composite output. Frontend build clean. New binary built and redeployed against the real running IDUNA, health-checked green. S416-01's own real gap (need a founder admin cookie session to browser-verify the logged-in UI) is honestly named, not bypassed -- every layer beneath it is real and verified. Commit e99e98f.

⚓ ☃
title: NOCK: real layer position/scale/rotation (S416-02)
